name: Teladoc Health
one_liner: The largest telehealth provider in the US, offering 24/7 virtual care including mental health services via BetterHelp integration.
short_description: Teladoc Health is the largest telehealth company in the US, providing virtual medical, mental health, and specialty care to millions through employer and insurance benefits.
long_description: Teladoc Health is the largest and most established telehealth company in the United States, publicly traded (NYSE: TDOC) and providing virtual care to over 90 million members worldwide. The platform offers 24/7 access to board-certified physicians for urgent care, primary care, mental health therapy, psychiatry, dermatology, and chronic care management. Teladoc acquired BetterHelp in 2015, making it one of the largest providers of virtual mental health services. The company serves thousands of employers and is in-network with most major insurance carriers. In 2025, Teladoc launched Wellbound, an employee assistance program integrating BetterHelp with psychiatry services. The platform is transitioning BetterHelp to accept insurance alongside its traditional subscription model.
best_for: Employees with Teladoc as a covered benefit through their employer
Patients seeking comprehensive telehealth (urgent care, mental health, specialty)
Adults needing quick access to therapy or psychiatry
not_for: Self-pay patients seeking budget options (premium pricing)
Practices looking for EHR or documentation tools (consumer-focused)

pricing.notes: Covered benefit for millions through employers and insurers. In-network with most major carriers. BetterHelp mental health services available. HSA/FSA accepted.

compliance.notes: Enterprise-grade compliance. Public company with comprehensive security certifications.

patient_experience.appointment_availability: Same-day or next-day in most states

services.provider_network_notes: Thousands of board-certified physicians and mental health professionals
services.mental_health_notes: Therapy via BetterHelp integration, psychiatry for medication management

faqs.a: With insurance or employer benefits, Teladoc costs $0-50 for medical, $0-90 for therapy, and $0-140 for psychiatry. Self-pay rates are $58-99 for medical, $90-119 for therapy, $215-299 for initial psychiatry, and $100-129 for follow-ups.

faqs.q: Is Teladoc the same as BetterHelp?
faqs.a: Teladoc acquired BetterHelp in 2015. BetterHelp operates as a subsidiary focused on therapy services, while Teladoc offers comprehensive telehealth including medical, psychiatry, and specialty care. In 2025-2026, BetterHelp is transitioning to accept insurance.

Yes, Teladoc is in-network with most major insurance carriers and is offered as a covered benefit by thousands of employers. You can check your coverage at TeladocHealth.com or through your benefits manager.

faqs.q: Can I see a psychiatrist through Teladoc?
faqs.a: Yes, Teladoc offers psychiatry services with 45-minute initial evaluations and 15-minute follow-ups for medication management. Costs range from $0-140 with insurance or $215-299 initial/$100-129 follow-up self-pay.
